_doc: Wave 3 tier C fill (2026-11-25): no-lean assay house; roots follow birthplace (Bạch Ngân silver mine, Song Kiều, the spring, the seat).

people.role: The head's grandson from the silver mine, who tested the weights; sent back to keep the house's counter at Bạch Ngân
people.appearance: Lays a spirit-level on every table he sits at; his left foot drags from a dropped ingot.
people.backstory: The head's grandson by his second son, raised at the silver mine; he tested the house weight on his cousin Tưởng Ngọc Cân's (tuong_ngoc_can) side of the square three times and found it true each time, because she always knew he was coming. This spring his grandfather sent him back to Bạch Ngân to keep the house's counter.

tree.intent: Metal; a true eye before a strong hand.

people.role: Keeper of the house's bath-house at Xuân Thủy Thang
people.appearance: Hair curled for good by bath-steam; her laugh carries through three walls.
people.backstory: Keeps the house's bath-house at Xuân Thủy Thang and lodges its clients while the furnace works on their metal; she sent her niece Khương Tiểu Kim (khuong_tieu_kim) to the scale because the girl could sort the bath's coins blind. She turned a coughing miner from the bath at the door because his coin was copper, and docked the bath-boy who carried him in to the street a week's rice.

tree.intent: Wood and Fire; a host's ward.

people.role: Outer disciple from the silver mine, at the furnace bellows
people.appearance: One eyebrow singed off and never regrown; forearms corded like rope.
people.backstory: Sorted the nine silvers blindfold in 1197 at her third try; she works the furnace bellows beside her brother Nghiêm Bạc Sinh (nghiem_bac_sinh) and is already the better at telling silver from lead by its smoke. She has twice pressed her brother's hand to the crucible rim to teach him smoke, and laughed at the blisters.

people.role: Inner disciple who writes up the morning's weighings on the square
people.appearance: Ink-blackened thumb, a pen behind the wrong ear, lips that move over every sum.
people.backstory: Writes up the morning's weighings and the good-side fees for Lã Minh Nhãn (la_minh_nhan); the house's side weighs nine baskets in ten on the square now, which he takes as proof of its honest scale. He copies yesterday's tally and changes the date, because he cannot hold today's sums in his head and will not say so, and leaves the weighing to Quản Thập Thù (quan_thap_thu), who is ninety-five.

ties.note: the old man who knows every weight

people.role: Outer disciple of the Ôn clan, sent under the kin rule
people.appearance: Brass toll tokens jingle at her belt with every step.
people.backstory: The Ôn clan's child for 1196, sent with no eye at all under the kin rule; she collects the bridge tolls for Ôn Song Ngọc (on_song_ngoc) and is much better at that than at the scale; she charged the porter Phàn Bối Sơn (phan_boi_son) a full toll for the Bridge Court's own case boxes, and he paid it from his own pocket.

people.role: Inner disciple who runs the night crucible
people.appearance: Charcoal-black creases around the eyes; squints at daylight like a man just woken.
people.backstory: A charcoal-burner's son from the house's own yard who runs the crucible at night; he keeps a Thối Tinh knife bought at the gate and has asked Phùng Xích Kim (phung_xich_kim) three times to let him fire it, and been told three times that the house does not assay unasked.

people.role: Outer disciple, the Tưởng child for 1197, under her mother's scale
people.appearance: Her morning shout cracks on its last word; a front tooth is coming in crooked.
people.backstory: Tưởng Ngọc Cân's (tuong_ngoc_can) daughter, who sits under her mother's scale and has been given the morning shout across the square; she shouts it louder than the Pivot's side and is proud of it.

tree.intent: Wood; a loud voice and a light hand.
